card.name: Gazing and looking verbs, or their objects
card.fires_on: Verbs of looking such as gazing, staring, looked and watched, and the object right after look at, as in 'look at me'. It fires in narrative prose describing someone's gaze.

modes.label: Looking verbs
modes.description: The verb of sight itself, such as gazing, staring, gazed or watched, in a scene description.
modes.example: Then, stepping to the side of the stand, he stood with folded arms g<<azing>> at the audience with quizzical look

modes.label: Object of a look
modes.description: The person or pronoun that comes right after look at or look the, naming who is being looked at.
modes.example: She looked at<< me>> with helplessness in her eyes.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated and mixed across languages.
card.plain: It lights up on words about someone looking at or staring at something, and on who is being looked at.
